# Updated Food Safety Guidelines (2024)

Modern food safety research has refined our understanding of bacterial growth thresholds.

## Temperature Control

Bacteria multiply rapidly between 5 °C and 63 °C. Food held in this range for more than two hours should be discarded. Refrigeration should maintain temperatures below 5 °C at all times.
